title: Report: George Kittle is expected to practice this week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: George Kittle is expected to practice this week
sources.description: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said after the team's final preseason game that tight end George Kittle had "taken a step back" when discussing Kittle's return from a torn Achilles, but Shanahan didn't elaborate on what that meant for his availability for the start of the regular season.
